topic: MOPs style fixes and Angular updates
summary_markdown:
A participant provided a pull request containing style fixes for MOPs. This PR was also pushed to the `angular 12 update` branch.

Discussion confirmed that the `angular 12 update` branch had not been merged into `develop` because testing was incomplete, but it is expected to be done soon. The participant who provided the fix stated that having fixes in this specific branch is acceptable.

Later, a query was made regarding an updated chart.js branch. A different participant clarified that they had not pushed any updates; rather, they had broken all charts configurations while attempting to test library compilation errors against the latest version of libraries.
decisions: Fixes for MOPs were provided via a pull request and pushed to the `angular 12 update` branch.
action_items: Complete testing and merge the `angular 12 update` branch into `develop` soon.
